messages:
Ibrahim (DevEx): Quick heads-up: example in monorepo fails only when running Vercel dev with pnpm workspace link. Error: "Package subpath './edge' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/packages/sdk-js/package.json".

Ibrahim (DevEx): Repro (super short): pnpm i at root -> cd examples/edge-playground && pnpm dev (vercel). import { RedwoodClient } from 'sdk-js' -> build fails during rollup/esbuild resolve.

Priya: That usually means bundler tried a subpath import (./edge) but package.json lacks that export. Also TS can fail to find types when hoisted; types need to be declared at package root via "types" field. Does npm pack workaround fix it?

Ibrahim (DevEx): Yes, installing the tarball works. Local workspace symlink fails. Also saw TS error: "Could not find declaration file for module 'sdk-js'" even though dist/types exist in package.

Omar: Short fixes: add explicit ./edge export -> point to dist/edge/index.mjs; add "module" and "browser" fields; add "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts". That helps rollup/esbuild and TS.

Ibrahim (DevEx): Another issue: on Edge, our auth refresh + fetch auto-retries caused multiple concurrent refreshes -> 401 loop. Logs: request -> 401 -> refresh start (A) -> fetch retry fires (B) -> also 401 -> triggers refresh (B) -> race -> loop.

Priya: We should implement single-flight refresh (share in-flight promise) and mark retries to not trigger refresh while refresh in progress. Also ensure retries pick up new token once available.

Omar: I'll PR package.json exports + types. Priya, can you own single-flight refresh + unit test that simulates double retry?

Test Bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/449 and branch fix/exports-edge-449

Ibrahim (DevEx): Adding docs blurb for pnpm workspace symlink pitfalls and recommend (a) npm pack, (b) local shim re-export, or (c) wait for SDK patch. Saving to onboarding checklist.
